reviews.text: The COSRX Hydrium Triple Hyaluronic Moisturizing Cleanser is a gentle, hydrating facial cleanser that effectively removes dirt and impurities without stripping the skin. Infused with multiple types of hyaluronic acid, it helps maintain moisture while cleansing, leaving the skin feeling soft, refreshed, and comfortable after use. The texture is smooth and slightly creamy, creating a light lather that works well for daily use, especially for dry or sensitive skin types. It’s a great option for those looking for a non-drying cleanser that supports hydration while keeping the skin barrier balanced
reviews.zh: COSRX Hydrium Triple Hyaluronic Moisturizing Cleanser 係一款溫和、補水嘅潔面產品，可以有效去除污垢同雜質，又唔會剝走皮膚水分。加入咗多種透明質酸，潔面嘅時候有助保持水分，用完之後皮膚感覺柔軟、清爽、舒適。質地幼滑、略帶奶霜感，起泡輕盈，日常使用都好好，尤其適合乾性或者敏感皮膚。如果你想搵一款唔會令皮膚乾燥、又能夠補充水分同平衡皮膚屏障嘅潔面產品，呢款係一個好選擇。

reviews.text: Great morning cleanser when you need something gentle to wash your face of all the skincare you put on overnight. I've used it as both a nighttime and morning cleanser when in a pinch, and it worked perfectly! Doesn't break my face out, or leave it tight, it leaves it pretty soft.
reviews.zh: 係一款好好嘅朝早潔面產品，當你需要溫和嘅嘢去洗走你晚上塗嘅所有護膚品時就最啱。我喺急用嗰時，朝早同晚上都當潔面用過，效果好好！唔會令我爆痘，亦唔會令面緊繃，洗完仲係好幼滑。

reviews.text: It’s a great quality product that I find removes almost all makeup without having to double cleanse. It builds to smooth foam but not too soapy and especially not drying. I’ve repurchased countless times and will continue to!
reviews.zh: 係一款質素好好嘅產品，我覺得佢幾乎可以卸晒妝，而且唔使雙重潔面。起泡幼滑，唔會太似肥皂，尤其唔會令皮膚乾燥。我已經買咗無數次，仲會繼續買！

reviews.text: this is a hydrating gentle on skin cleanser that also includes actives to improve the efficacy of a deeper cleanse than a basic gentle cleanser would be great for dry combo or combination skin imo
reviews.zh: 呢款係一款補水、對皮膚溫和嘅潔面產品，仲含有活性成分，令潔面效果比一般溫和潔面產品更深層。我覺得啱乾性混合或者混合性皮膚，我個人睇法。

reviews.text: Will be purchasing again for sure. This is the first facial wash I've tried that did not leave my skin feeling tight and dry after washing. Totally satisfied! Been singing praise about this to my sister - she recently bought one and is very happy with it too!
reviews.zh: 一定會再買。呢個係我試過嘅第一款潔面產品，洗完之後皮膚唔會緊繃同乾燥。好滿意！我一直都好讚呢款產品畀我個 sister——佢最近都買咗，而且好滿意！

reviews.text: If you have dry skin, including those more mature, you must try this! It's soft and creamy and you only need a small amount. It lathers up a bit and rinses away easily. No detectable smell. My skin doesn't feel dry after I towel dry. It's fantastic. Absolutely recommend.
reviews.zh: 如果你皮膚乾，包括較成熟嘅皮膚，一定要試吓呢款！佢質地柔軟、似奶霜，只需要少少份量。起泡少少，好容易沖洗乾淨。完全冇咩味道。用毛巾抹乾之後，我嘅皮膚都唔會覺得乾。好好，絕對推薦。

reviews.text: Got a sample of the this line and fell in love! I bought this whole line for my winter ready skin or even if I’m doing retinol treatment that night! Corx please never drop these products!
reviews.zh: 拎咗呢個系列嘅試用裝，即刻就愛上咗！我買咗成個系列，用嚟準備好過冬嘅皮膚，又或者晚上做維A醇（retinol）護理嗰陣都用得！Corx 拜託唔好停產呢啲產品！

reviews.text: Amazing face wash! It’s best for oily to combo skin. It’s really foamy, and soft, but it does dry our your face a little. So if you have really dry skin, this might not be the best for you. Otherwise, I really like it and I’m already seeing good results from it!
reviews.zh: 非常好嘅洗面奶！最適合油性至混合性皮膚。起泡非常豐富、質地柔軟，不過會令你面乾身少少。所以如果你皮膚真係好乾，呢款可能唔係最適合你。除此之外，我真係好鍾意，而且已經見到好效果！

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
